notes.title: The Lacerator Launches On October 9th!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2][p]It's been 3 long years of development, 2 years working on this project in my free time, and then 1 year of full-time development! I'm happy to finally announce that [b][i]THE LACERATOR[/i][/b] has a release date!

Drum rolls.....

[b][i]THE LACERATOR LAUNCHES ON OCTOBER 9TH![/i][/b] 

You'll soon be able to step into the shoes of Max and find your way out of this psycho's hideout, hopefully in one piece! 

This is a really special game to me that I truly handcrafted and I'm excited as hell to release it and hear what people think about it, see players' reactions, laughs, scares etc. We also have another surprise, here you go, the grindhouse release date trailer! See ya in a few weeks  [/p][list][*][p]Fernando Tittz[/p][/*][/list][previewyoutube="ClOZVDTj-Fk;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The Lacerator Dev Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It's been a while since you've been updated on the progress that's been made in [i][b]The Lacerator[/b][/i], and we wanted to keep you all in the loop! Games From The Abyss has been toiling away in Max's journey, and he can't wait for you all to see what's in store (Like the new badass Key Art)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734692/8f59da61a2331dfc217321ff57bbc8210c234695.png[/img]

We wanted to try and do one of these occasionally to show off some environments, enemies, and weapons or just random things Fernando has made for the game. 

Meet...

[h2][b]THE MINDLESS CRAWLER[/b][/h2]

The Mindless Crawler will chase Max around the Lacerators labyrinth. Even without legs, he still has to end Max's life one way or another because if Max doesn’t finish them off, The Lacerator will rip them to shreds in his furious rage. As you can see, he has a bomb strapped to his back, which will go off when he gets close to Max. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734692/272cfa3bdf44ff97876d237aa2133d72a24c3a37.gif[/img]

Max will have to be fast or have good aim to take these guys down before their bomb goes off! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734692/94aa986becf259288197ba08d379c3ef6652531d.gif[/img]


We are excited to start showing off more of what goes into making [i][b]The Lacerator[/b][/i], especially as we go into launch year!

notes.title: 'Don't get lacerated!' is a bullet-point feature in limb-lopping survival horror game The Lacerator
notes.content: DreadXP has announced it's publishing a new horror game from Brazilian Studio Games From the Abyss called The Lacerator, and it's a wilfully old school survival horror experience. As the mature content description on its Steam page warns, "This game contains scenes of explicit violence and gore, also contains sensitive themes and tank controls"... Read more.

notes.title: THE LACERATOR!
notes.content:
[h2]Attention, THE LACERATOR is for Adult Audiences Only![/h2]

The shocking, graphic, and sensual nature of [b]THE LACERATOR[/b] is not for the weak of heart!

Games From The Abyss and DreadXP are not responsible for any adverse reactions to [b]THE LACERATOR[/b].

If you experience terror for more than 4 hours while playing [b]THE LACERATOR[/b], please seek professional help!

[previewyoutube=OPU3Su1cm1o;full][/previewyoutube]

Developer [i]Games From The Abyss[/i] and publisher [i]DreadXP[/i] form an unholy tryst as they join as one in the creation of [b]THE LACERATOR[/b], a gore-soaked survival horror game so low-brow it isn’t even allowed near an art museum.

Bursting at the seams with the grime and charm of the 80’s grindhouse, [b]THE LACERATOR[/b] is coming to a small screen near you soon.
